scope.target: http://127.0.0.1:8747/ (local serve of the s9-site worktree; public URL https://nguyenvanlamm.github.io/tapioca-junction-site/)
scope.audience: adults 25-50 who play calm logic puzzles on iPhone
scope.primary_goal: explain the game and its prices before launch (Coming soon, no store link); route questions to support
limitations: No performance timings in the evidence bundle; no profiler run (outside services forbidden)
Screenshots only at 390x844 and 1280x800; 320 px, tablet widths, zoom/reflow and landscape not tested
No keyboard or screen-reader run; accessibility is source + screenshot + computed contrast only
Local server serves the site at /, so 404.html absolute /tapioca-junction-site/ paths do not resolve in the capture
Deployed headers and real crawler access not verified; no crawler logs
Support/privacy screenshots show the light colour scheme only

evidence.observation: captured_at 2026-11-17T04:40:00Z; horizontal overflow none at 390 on index, support, privacy, 404; Sora+DM Mono on index, support/privacy system-ui only; no timing measurements
evidence.limitations: Capture-time lab evidence, not field data

evidence.observation: Render-blocking Google Fonts stylesheet (Sora 400/600/700, DM Mono 400/500); .facts li::before content "● "; hero CTA 'See how a jar plays out' links to #how (three text steps); flavour card lists 5 stamps; price list in USD with no 'free to download' or local-price note
Light default palette (#F6F2EA bg, #211D19 ink, #6D3FA0 links) with a dark override only under prefers-color-scheme: dark; system-ui font; no icon/brand header
Night Signal dark stage, gradient CTA, Sora/DM Mono render; no overflow; hero shot shows a heart-stamped cup; layout stacks to one column at 390
Both pages render cream background, dark system-ui text, purple links, no icon or gradient: visually unrelated to the index the CTA comes from
evidence.limitations: Light scheme only; dark-scheme render not captured

evidence.observation: Night Signal styling, noindex, links back home/support/privacy; icon shows broken in capture because paths are absolute /tapioca-junction-site/ while the local server roots the site at /
evidence.limitations: Correct on the Pages project path in principle; deployed render not verified

evidence.observation: Site-path robots.txt documents allow-all intent incl. AI bots and points to the sitemap; sitemap lists /, support.html, privacy.html with lastmod 2026-11-17, matching each page's self canonical
evidence.limitations: Crawlers read robots.txt only at host root

evidence.observation: Host-root robots.txt allows all and lists 32 project sitemaps but not tapioca-junction-site; host-root llms.txt has no Tapioca Junction entry
evidence.limitations: Captured before the planned root chore commit

evidence.observation: Valid llms.txt shape (H1, blockquote, facts, Pages list with 3 absolute links); says 7 flavours incl. lychee (heart) and brown sugar (swirl), starting helps 3/3/2, free to download, Coming soon

evidence.method: JSON-LD parse and comparison with visible text
evidence.observation: VideoGame+MobileApplication with creativeWorkStatus Upcoming, no offers or ratings; WebSite; FAQPage whose 5 Q&As match the visible dl; support/privacy WebPage linked by @id
evidence.limitations: No external validator run (not allowed); rich-result eligibility not assessed

evidence.observation: ink3/stage 7.17, ink3/stage2 6.68, ink2/stage2 9.58, accentText/stage2 12.31, white on #8951BF/#AB3B89/#CC2553 5.26/5.65/5.31, support light muted 6.83, light link 6.56: all >= 4.5

evidence.observation: Game defines lychee and brown sugar flavours in addition to the 5 the index card names
evidence.limitations: Did not check which menus use them

evidence.observation: assets/game.webp 28.6 KB (served via <picture>), game.png fallback 276 KB, share-card.jpg 67 KB, icon-180.png 30 KB; no JavaScript

coverage.rationale: Index and 404 hold the approved Night Signal style; support and privacy (the goal's destination) render as a cream system-ui page with no icon
No horizontal overflow at 390 on all four pages; clean 1-column stack at 390 and 2-column hero at 1280. Untested: 320 px, 768-820 breakpoint, zoom/reflow, landscape
Computed contrast passes on all token pairs; headings, lang, alt text and landmarks sound in source. Decorative fact bullets are exposed as text. Keyboard and screen-reader runs not done
No timings in the bundle and no profiler allowed. Payload looks small (no JS, 28.6 KB webp hero) but a render-blocking third-party font stylesheet is a hypothesis to measure

Coming soon is stated with no store badge or link; prices are listed; support is reachable from hero-end CTA and footer. Hero CTA label overpromises and the price block omits base-price and currency context
Site sitemap and canonicals agree and 404 is noindex, but the host-root robots.txt (the only one crawlers read) does not yet list this sitemap
JSON-LD parses, uses fitting types, carries Upcoming status, invents no offers/ratings, and the FAQ matches visible text. Engine eligibility not assessed
No Markdown route is documented or required; three short public pages plus a full llms.txt summary make .md twins duplicate content
Site llms.txt is well-formed with valid links and matches the game source, but the visible page lags it on flavours, and the host-root llms.txt has no entry yet
Intent (allow search, AI input and training) is consistent across site and host robots; all content is in the static initial HTML with no JS. Deployed headers and verified-bot access not tested
Pre-launch brochure with no user content or task output to copy, export or hand to an AI; share actions belong to the virality member (viral-product-evaluator)

findings.title: Support and privacy pages drop the Night Signal style
findings.recommendation: Give support.html and privacy.html the index tokens: dark stage #140C09, ink #F8F4F1/#C6BBB4, links #E0CEF8, color-scheme dark (drop the light branch), Sora/DM Mono, and a 40 px icon + 'Tapioca Junction' header linking home; keep the content unchanged

findings.title: Hero CTA promises a jar playing out but lands on three text steps
findings.recommendation: Relabel the hero button 'See how it plays' (target #how unchanged)

findings.title: Price block omits that the download is free and that prices are US dollars
findings.recommendation: Change the 'What it costs' lead to: 'Free to download. The first two menus are free to play from start to finish. Prices in US dollars; the App Store shows your local price.'

findings.title: Index flavour card names 5 stamps; llms.txt, the game and the hero shot have 7
findings.recommendation: Add 'lychee a heart, brown sugar a swirl' to the 'A stamp for every flavour' card so page and llms.txt agree

findings.title: Host-root robots.txt and llms.txt do not yet list Tapioca Junction
findings.recommendation: In the nguyenvanlamm.github.io repo add 'Sitemap: https://nguyenvanlamm.github.io/tapioca-junction-site/sitemap.xml' and a llms.txt bullet linking .../tapioca-junction-site/llms.txt (one chore commit)

findings.title: Decorative fact bullets are exposed to assistive tech
findings.recommendation: Use alt-text generated content (content: "● " / "") or a CSS dot (inline-block 6px circle, background var(--taro)) so VoiceOver does not read 'black circle' before each fact (WCAG 1.3.1)

findings.title: Possible first-render delay from the render-blocking Google Fonts stylesheet (unmeasured)
findings.recommendation: Measure first; if fonts delay first paint, self-host woff2 subsets of Sora 400/600/700 and DM Mono 400/500 with preload and font-display swap, which also removes the only third-party request

plan.title: Lab-measure index load on the deployed URL
plan.expected_impact: Turns the performance hypothesis into data
acceptance_checks: Record LCP, CLS and font-load timing for the Pages URL at 390 px with tool, date and settings noted; repeat once to confirm

plan.title: Verify deployed 404 and asset paths on GitHub Pages
plan.expected_impact: Confirms the broken 404 icon is a local-capture artefact only
acceptance_checks: A missing URL under /tapioca-junction-site/ returns status 404 with the icon, home button, support and privacy links all resolving

plan.title: Apply Night Signal to support and privacy
plan.expected_impact: Visitors routed to support stay in a recognisably same site
acceptance_checks: 390 px screenshots of support and privacy in both light and dark OS schemes show the dark stage, Sora headings and the icon header

plan.title: Hide decorative fact bullets from assistive tech
plan.expected_impact: Cleaner screen-reader reading of the hero facts
acceptance_checks: VoiceOver on iOS Safari reads 'No ads, No timers or lives...' without 'black circle'; dots still visible at 390 and 1280

plan.title: List the site in host-root robots.txt and llms.txt
plan.expected_impact: Crawlers find the sitemap from the robots file they actually read
acceptance_checks: https://nguyenvanlamm.github.io/robots.txt contains the tapioca-junction-site Sitemap line and root llms.txt links its llms.txt; both URLs return 200

plan.title: Name all seven flavour stamps on the index
acceptance_checks: Flavour card lists 7 flavours and stamps identical to llms.txt

plan.title: Add free-download and currency note to prices
acceptance_checks: 'What it costs' states free download and USD/local-price note; no store link or badge added

plan.title: Relabel the hero CTA
plan.expected_impact: Button label matches what the reader gets
acceptance_checks: Hero button reads 'See how it plays' and still jumps to #how by mouse and keyboard

plan.title: Self-host fonts only if T1 shows a font delay
plan.expected_impact: Faster first render and no third-party request, if measured as needed
acceptance_checks: Same T1 test shows earlier text render; no request to fonts.googleapis.com or fonts.gstatic.com; Sora/DM Mono still render
